content_blocks.label: clause_1._NOTICE_TO_QUIT
content_blocks.text: The Tenant is hereby notified to vacate the premises at 123 Main Street by February 15, 2025.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_REASONS_FOR_EVICTION
content_blocks.text: The Tenant has failed to pay rent in full as required by the lease agreement.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._ACTION_REQUIRED
content_blocks.text: Failure to comply with this notice may result in legal action for eviction.
